description: This file contains benchmark tests for the Abseil cctz time library, including functions for date calculations, timezone loading, and time formatting/parsing benchmarks.

methods.name: BM_Difference_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for calculating difference in days between two civil days.

methods.name: BM_Step_Days
methods.description: Benchmark for incrementing a civil day.

methods.name: BM_GetWeekday
methods.description: Benchmark for getting the weekday of a civil day.

methods.name: BM_NextWeekday
methods.description: Benchmark for computing the next weekday given a starting day and target weekday.

methods.name: BM_PrevWeekday
methods.description: Benchmark for computing the previous weekday given a starting day and target weekday.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadUTCTimeZoneFirst
methods.description: Benchmark for loading UTC timezone first, testing cache behavior.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadUTCTimeZoneLast
methods.description: Benchmark for loading multiple time zones to prime cache, then loading UTC.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadTimeZoneFirst
methods.description: Benchmark for loading a specific timezone, testing cache behavior.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadTimeZoneCached
methods.description: Benchmark for loading a cached timezone.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadLocalTimeZoneCached
methods.description: Benchmark for loading local timezone with cache primed.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadAllTimeZonesFirst
methods.description: Benchmark for loading all time zones sequentially, testing cache population.

methods.name: BM_Zone_LoadAllTimeZonesCached
methods.description: Benchmark for loading all time zones with cache already populated.

methods.name: BM_Zone_TimeZoneEqualityImplicit
methods.description: Benchmark for implicit timezone equality check.

methods.name: BM_Zone_TimeZoneEqualityExplicit
methods.description: Benchmark for explicit timezone equality check.

methods.name: BM_Zone_UTCTimeZone
methods.description: Benchmark for retrieving UTC timezone repeatedly.

methods.name: BM_Time_ToCivil_CCTZ
methods.description: Benchmark for converting system clock time to civil time using cctz.

methods.name: BM_Time_ToCivil_Libc
methods.description: Benchmark for converting system clock time to civil time using libc localtime.

methods.name: BM_Time_ToCivilUTC_CCTZ
methods.description: Benchmark for converting UTC system clock time to civil time using cctz.

methods.name: BM_Time_ToCivilUTC_Libc
methods.description: Benchmark for converting UTC system clock time to civil time using libc gmtime.

methods.name: BM_Time_FromCivil_CCTZ
methods.description: Benchmark for converting civil time to system clock time using cctz.

methods.name: BM_Time_FromCivil_Libc
methods.description: Benchmark for converting civil time to system clock time using libc mktime.

methods.name: BM_Time_FromCivilUTC_CCTZ
methods.description: Benchmark for converting civil UTC time to system clock using cctz.

methods.name: BM_Time_FromCivilDay0_CCTZ
methods.description: Benchmark for civil time with day=0 using cctz.

methods.name: BM_Time_FromCivilDay0_Libc
methods.description: Benchmark for civil time with day=0 using libc.

methods.name: BM_Format_FormatTime
methods.description: Benchmark for formatting time into string with various formats.

methods.name: BM_Format_ParseTime
methods.description: Benchmark for parsing time string into time object with various formats.
